description: Leaf-shaped crystal veined orange and red. It stays warm in the pouch, like the shell it was prised from.
lore: Blood heat, near enough, and it keeps it for years. That makes it the one piece of junk with an obvious use and no cleverness required: it goes in a pocket, and the pocket is warm.

[[characters/cfe826c1|Jehanne]] buys them by the sack every autumn — the cracked and cloudy ones, which is why she can afford sacks — and hands them out on the winter rounds to whoever is sitting up at a fire with no one else on the rota. She says nothing over them. She has nothing to say over them. An old man at the third fire thanked her last year for the blessing, and she stood a moment, and then told him he was welcome, because correcting him would have cost him something and saved her nothing at all.
